reviews.name: 정****
reviews.content:
개봉하여 꺼내는 순간 디자인과 칼라가 너무 맘에 들었습니다.
펼쳐서 바람을 넣어보니 이중막이라 새지 않아서 굿굿.
해수욕장 가기 이틀전에 바람을 넣어뒀지만 끄덕 없었음.
애개육아템으로 넘 좋았고, 컨디션이 별로라 하필임 해변에 가서 아이가 타지 않을려고 해서 아쉬웠지만, 넉넉한 공간에 바닥이 탄탄했음. 
리드줄을 달아 멀리 가더라도 다시 편하게 데리고 올수 있었고.. 다들 너무 이쁘다고 어디서 구입했는지 물어보셨어요.
홍보 열심히 했다그요 ㅋㅋㅋ 

사용후 바람도 잘 빠지고, 접어서 정리하기 딱 좋았습니다
해마다 사용하기 너무 좋을듯.
우리 강아지들이 튜브맛을 알고 수영을 안할려고 해서 문제였지만… 최애 튜브임.
reviews.content_en: The moment I opened it and took it out, I loved the design and color so much. I inflated it and checked it out - the double layer prevents any leaks, which is great! I inflated it two days before going to the beach and it held perfectly. It was such a great item for raising my pup, and it was a shame that my dog didn't want to get on it because he wasn't feeling well that day, but the spacious interior and sturdy bottom were impressive. I attached a leash so I could easily bring him back even if he wandered off, and everyone kept asking where I bought it because they thought it looked so pretty. I guess I did a good job promoting it ㅋㅋㅋ After use, the air deflated nicely and it was perfect for folding and storing. I think we'll use it every year. The only issue was that my dogs got a taste of the tube and didn't want to swim anymore... but it's definitely our favorite tube.

reviews.name: 지****
reviews.content:
#체험단 

저희 강아지랑 물놀이하려고 신청했는데 크기도 디자인도 너무 만족합니다! 동글동글 디자인이 정말 귀엽고 사진도 예쁘게 잘 나와요. 튜브도 밑에가 생각보다 튼튼하고 저희 강아디가 안에서 안정감 있게 앉아 있어서 안심하고 사용할 수 있을거같아요!  등길이가 긴 저희 강아지가 엎드려도 널널해서 다견가정도 문제 없을거같고, 소재도 탄탄하고 공기 주입도 어렵지 않아 사용하기 편할것같아요!
reviews.content_en: #Review I applied to use this for water play with my puppy, and I'm so satisfied with both the size and design! The round design is really cute and takes beautiful photos. The bottom of the tube is sturdier than expected, and my pup sits inside with great stability, so I feel confident using it! My dog has a long back, and even when lying down there's plenty of space, so it should work fine for multi-dog households. The material is sturdy and inflating isn't difficult, so it should be very convenient to use!

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
#체험단
강아지랑 수영장 있는 애견 펜션 가려고 신청했는데 실물이 더 크고 귀여워요 
바람 불자마자 강아지가 먼저 들어가서 앉아 있어요 
강아지가 편안해 하고 좋아하니 다행이에요
바람도 잘 들어가고 불기도 편해서 금방 불었어요
여행이 한달 뒤라 여행 가서도 튜브랑 강아지랑 찍으면 더 이쁘게 나올것 같아요
저희 강아지가 5키로인데 두마리도 들어갈 정도로 충분히 넉넉 합니다!!
reviews.content_en: #Review I applied to go to a dog-friendly pension with a pool, and the actual product is even bigger and cuter than I expected! As soon as I inflated it, my dog went in and sat down right away. I'm so glad my dog feels comfortable and likes it. The air goes in well and it's easy to inflate, so it filled up quickly. Our trip is a month away, so I think it'll look even prettier when we take photos with the tube and my dog there. My dog weighs 5kg and it's spacious enough to fit two dogs!!

reviews.name: 최****
reviews.content:
실물이 엄청크고 튼튼하고 견고해서 오래쓸거같아요 
그리고 너무 귀여여워요 얼른 놀러가서 태워보고싶어요 
저희아이가 작아서 다 커보이는거 같아요 ♡
reviews.content_en: The actual product is really big, sturdy, and solid - I think we'll use it for a long time. And it's so cute! I can't wait to go play and try it out soon. Since my pup is small, it looks even bigger! ♡

reviews.name: 신****
reviews.content:
와 체험단으로 튜브 당첨되었어요🤩미니핀 아기 태워줄려고 신청했는데 래브라도 아기가 더 관심을 보이네요ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ아직 미니핀아가는 적응이 조금 더 필요할거같아요ㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ거실에 계속 두고 있는대 요즘은 가서 냄새도 맡고 안에 들어가기도 한대요 정말 밑에 바닥도 안미끄럽고 튼튼해보여요 잘 터지지 않을거 같아요💖조만간 수영장에서 사용 후 후기 올릴께요🥰

#체험단
reviews.content_en: Wow, I won a tube as a review team member! 🤩 I applied to put my Mini Pinscher puppy on it, but my Labrador puppy is showing more interest ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ I think my Mini Pinscher still needs a bit more time to adapt ㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ I keep it in the living room and lately she goes over to sniff it and even gets inside. The bottom really doesn't slip and looks so sturdy! I don't think it'll pop easily 💖 I'll post a review after using it at the pool soon! 🥰

reviews.name: 정****
reviews.content_en: It's bigger than I thought and so cute ㅠㅠ

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content: 이 튜브 넘 맘에 들어요.  물에 띄워놓으니 색깔도 예쁘고 모양도 귀여워요.  계곡에 가서 잘 썼어요.  사람 아기가 써도 좋을거 같아요.
reviews.content_en: I love this tube so much. When I put it in the water, the color looks pretty and the shape is adorable. We used it great when we went to the valley. I think it would be good for human babies too.

reviews.name: 윤****
reviews.content:
12개월 아기도 탈 수 있어요. 미끄럼방지 되어 있다고 해서 구매했는데 사람 동생도 탈 수 있네요! 물 놀이 처음 하는 아기라 적응이 필요 했는데 비숑 오빠 덕을 봤어요~^^. 9키로 정도 되는 사람 아가도 안정적으로 탈 수 있어요. 5키로 비숑도 안전하게 앉아서 물 놀이 즐길 수 있어요. 
단점은 튜브 바람마개를 잠그기 전에 바람 넣은게 엄청 슝숭 빠져 나가요... 이게 좀 단점이에요. 보완해야될 듯 싶어요.
reviews.content_en: Even a 12-month-old baby can ride it. I bought it because it's supposed to have anti-slip features, and it turns out my human sibling can ride it too! Since my baby was just starting water play, they needed to adjust, but my older Bichon brother helped a lot~^^ A human baby weighing around 9kg can ride it stably. My 5kg Bichon can also sit safely and enjoy water play. The downside is that before I screwed on the air valve cap, the air leaked out really quickly... that's a bit of a downside. I think it needs to be improved.

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 배송도 빠른편이고 너무너뮤이뻐요! 제가 타고싶을정도..? ㅋㅋ 아기가 좋아해서 다행이에요 얼른 놀러가고싶어요!
reviews.content_en: Shipping was fast and it's so so pretty! I even want to ride it myself..? ㅋㅋ I'm glad my baby likes it. Can't wait to go play soon!

reviews.name: 박****
reviews.content:
동생이 물놀이간다고 사달래서 사줬는데
좋아하네요
튜브 너무 귀여워요~~~
reviews.content_en: My sibling asked me to buy one because they were going water playing, and they like it. The tube is so cute~~~
